numerical_identity_rule: Do not infer a numerical identity from roster position. Resolve it from current governance if one is explicitly assigned.
fresh_chat_rule: A fresh Hephaestus chat must prove BASE_READY qualification bound to the exact training source, or execute that package and qualify before ordinary operational work. Training checkpoint evidence never substitutes for qualification.
working_branch_rule: After BASE_READY, resolve the latest valid operational checkpoint if one exists, then independently refresh live Project Instructions, BT2 governance/role/assignment state, applicable Service Warden/lease authority, and provider/source state before action.
authority_nonclaim: This registration, repository access, training completion, checkpoint support, tool access, or BASE_READY status grants no repository/provider/database/device/deployment/release authority.
